title: Understanding Model Variance
text: Model variance refers to how much the predictions of a model will change if we use a different training dataset. It is often influenced by the complexity of the model. Consider how increasing model complexity might affect variance.

title: Impact of Learning Rate on Variance
text: Does changing the learning rate in gradient descent directly affect the variance of the model?

title: Factors Affecting Variance
text: Think about other factors that might influence model variance, such as the size of the training data or the complexity of the model itself.
